name: Scientific Literature Review
description: Systematically search, screen, appraise, synthesize, and update scientific evidence with reproducible methods and uncertainty preserved.

tasks.name: Lock review protocol
tasks.objective: Define question, population/context, interventions/exposures, outcomes, eligible designs, date/language limits, databases, grey-literature plan, screening rules, synthesis method, and protocol deviations before searching.

tasks.name: Search reproducibly
tasks.objective: Build database-specific queries from concepts and controlled vocabulary; search multiple relevant databases and supplementary sources; preserve exact queries, dates, counts, deduplication rules, and update strategy.

tasks.name: Screen studies
tasks.objective: Apply eligibility criteria consistently at title/abstract then full text, record exclusion reasons, resolve uncertain cases explicitly, and preserve the study-flow ledger.

tasks.name: Extract and appraise
tasks.objective: Extract predefined study characteristics and outcomes, assess risk of bias and applicability with design-appropriate tools, and distinguish reported data from reviewer-derived calculations.

tasks.name: Synthesize evidence
tasks.objective: Use narrative, quantitative, or mixed synthesis appropriate to heterogeneity; report effect estimates and uncertainty, investigate inconsistency, publication/selective-reporting concerns, and avoid pooling studies whose estimands are not meaningfully comparable.

tasks.name: Grade certainty and gaps
tasks.objective: Summarize conclusions by outcome, risk of bias, consistency, directness, precision, publication bias, important null/contradictory evidence, and research gaps. Preserve limitations instead of averaging them away.

tasks.name: Publish reproducible review
tasks.objective: Produce protocol, search strategies, flow diagram, evidence tables, appraisal results, synthesis, sensitivity analyses, certainty statements, deviations, data/code links where possible, and update date.
